interface_type_note: Dominant surface is a request-builder form (state + typed questions) with a data-output column (decisions, metrics) and an export dock; evaluated as form per the dominant type, with dashboard rules applied to the metrics panel and AI-transparency rules applied to the confidence displays.

findings.message: The question list grows unbounded and every card keeps its editors fully expanded. Past roughly 8 questions the builder becomes a long scroll of equally-weighted cards, diluting attention on the question being edited.
findings.remediation: Collapse question cards that were not edited in the current session to a one-line summary (id, type, instructions) with an expand control. Measure: time to locate and edit one question in a 10-question request.

findings.message: Run history persists silently in localStorage with a hard cap of 20 entries and no indication of scope or lifetime; users may expect history to survive across devices or to be exportable.
findings.remediation: Label the history block with its scope (this browser only) and offer a JSON export of the run log next to Clear.

strengths.message: Offline concept validation blocks the Run action on hard errors (invalid JSON, duplicate or invalid answer keys, score level counts, choice limits) and warns on known Jev failure patterns (compound questions, text-generation asks, math/date asks) before any token is spent. Loading an example over an edited request asks for confirmation first.

Four one-click examples (ticket triage, prompt-injection guardrail, moderation, lead scoring) plus a prefilled default request make the state/questions/decisions model learnable in seconds; the empty-question state points directly at the examples.

Every answer card carries the explicit note that confidence describes the distribution rather than guaranteed correctness; noul shows a clearly labelled derived certainty; band badges (auto/review/abstain) carry hover explanations of the 0.90/0.50 thresholds.

The primary Run action is reachable from every scroll position on mobile (fixed bottom bar) and from the keyboard anywhere (Ctrl/Cmd+Enter); destructive row actions are secondary ghost buttons with 36px minimum targets.

One accent colour, one radius system, semantic band hues reserved for real state, labels above inputs with helper text and inline errors, and a single form pattern applied across state, questions and export surfaces in both languages and themes.

Complete state cycle: skeleton loading during a run, toasts for completion/failure/export/example-load, per-answer raw JSON disclosure, run history with latency sparkline, and empty states that say how to populate them.
